limitations: Approval is limited to grounding the storage_unknown question-suggestion evaluation.
The item does not recommend a provider or moving-service model.
The fixture does not establish that the broader six-model moving-service knowledge set is complete or ready for comparison.

items.statement: For an interstate move handled by a household-goods mover, a possible need for temporary storage before final delivery is relevant when identifying the services to request.
items.source: U.S. DOT, FMCSA, Your Rights and Responsibilities When You Move, https://www.fmcsa.dot.gov/sites/fmcsa.dot.gov/files/2023-10/FMCSA_R%26R_Handbook_Web_v1.pdf (rev. Oct. 2022)
items.freshness_guidance: Review every 24 months or sooner if FMCSA revises or withdraws the handbook; not valid for provider offerings, prices, or availability.
